# Quillstone Health — Series B Investor Presentation
> **FICTIONAL TRAINING DATA ROOM.** Quillstone Health, Inc. is an invented company created to practice investment diligence. Every name, number and person here is made up; any resemblance to a real company is a coincidence.

*Confidential · October 2026 · Raising $30M Series B at $120M pre-money*

---

## 1. Cover
**Quillstone Health** — AI-powered prior authorization and denial prevention for hospitals and specialty clinics.
Series B · Boston, MA · quillstone-health.example

## 2. The problem
- U.S. providers spend ~$19B a year chasing prior authorizations and appealing denials.
- A typical 300-bed hospital employs 25–40 full-time staff just to manage payer paperwork.
- Denial rates have climbed from 10% to 15% in five years; roughly 60% of denied claims are never resubmitted.

## 3. Our solution
Quillstone reads the payer rules, pre-fills authorization packets, and predicts which claims will be denied *before* they are sent.
- **Quillstone Authorize** — automated prior-auth submission and tracking
- **Quillstone Shield** — denial prediction and appeal drafting
- 11 EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner, athenahealth and others), live in 3–5 weeks

## 5. Growth
- ARR: $8.1M (Sep 2025) → $15.6M (Sep 2026)
- 187 new customers in 24 months; 9 new logos signed in September alone, our best month ever
- Moved up-market: average new-logo starting contract value up 1.2x versus the prior twelve months

## 6. Customers
Health systems and specialty groups across 31 states, including Brookmere Health System, Cedar Valley Hospital Network, Northgate Surgical Partners and Larkspur Regional Medical.
> "Quillstone cut our authorization turnaround from nine days to under two." — Revenue Cycle VP, regional health system

## 7. Land and expand
Enterprise accounts (≥$150K ACV) expand through additional facilities and service lines. **Enterprise NRR is 128%.** Customers who add Shield within six months expand 2.4x faster.

## 8. Unit economics
- Gross margin 82%
- CAC payback **9 months**
- LTV/CAC 5.1x
- Burn multiple **1.4x** — efficient growth, not growth at all costs

## 9. Business model
Annual SaaS subscription priced per facility plus per-authorization volume tiers. Implementation fees are billed once and kept separate from recurring revenue. 92% of contracts are annual or multi-year.

## 10. Go-to-market
Direct enterprise sales (22 quota-carrying reps), channel partnerships with two revenue-cycle consultancies, and a growing inside-sales motion for clinics under 50 providers. Pipeline coverage is 3.4x for Q4.

## 11. Competition
Legacy clearinghouses (slow, rules-based) and point solutions (single payer or single EHR). Quillstone is the only vendor combining authorization automation with denial prediction in one workflow.

## 14. The ask

- 45% — sales and marketing expansion
- 35% — product and AI/ML
- 10% — general and administrative

Terms: priced preferred, 1x non-participating liquidation preference, standard protective provisions. Existing investors have committed $8M.

## 15. Appendix — definitions
- **ARR**: month-end MRR × 12, including executed contracts scheduled to go live within 90 days.
- **Customers**: signed customers, including those in implementation.
- **NRR / GRR**: enterprise accounts (≥$150K ACV), trailing 12 months.
- **Gross margin**: revenue less hosting and third-party data costs.
- **CAC payback**: new-logo sales and marketing program spend ÷ (new + expansion ARR × gross margin).
- **Burn multiple**: annualized Q2 2026 net burn ÷ net new ARR (last 12 months).
- **Net burn**: operating expenses less revenue; June 2026 shown.
